annotations.title: Benny Andersson: Falling Piano Arpeggio
annotations.instruction: Keep wrist low and flexible across the 6 sharps of F# Major. Let the high C#5 ring above the driving eighth notes.

annotations.title: Dramatic Chorus Weight Transfer
annotations.instruction: Drop full arm weight into the bass octaves while voicing the soaring soprano melody (The winner takes it all!).
